Leo has practiced football for three years and won a prize last term. Little by little, things began to change. Leo believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Also, they moved to the suburbs last year.

On Tuesday evenings, Leo reviews the notes from class. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Grace always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Best of all, time is a difficult concept for children.

The bus terminal looked quieter than usual that evening. Grace and Leo are preparing a report about the bus terminal. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The chef tried an experimental dish with seaweed.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Leo wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Best of all, the market stall sells ripe figs.
Leo is saving money to buy a ticket to Sydney. People around Leo often share different ideas about the bus terminal. Leo thanked Grace for the honest advice.
